environment.frontend_scope: Per-job bounded cache snapshots after each completed chunk. Fallback count includes cache-capacity misses only; above-limit eager calls are not counted. Input/output bytes exclude graph-private intermediate pools/workspaces. No cache eviction.

config.scope: Full output/quality regression, one pass per variant. Includes warmup/capture/I/O; no steady-state latency or speedup claim. Long-form has joined text/segments only. No human timestamp or reference translation annotation.
